posts.cooked:
Hello, so my older brother is a writer who has also played and is a fan of Sentinels. He has also written a series of fantasy novels about a diverse group of travellers settling new lands in a fantasy setting. He is participating in a contest on inkshares where if there are enough preorders of the book, then it can be published. So take a look, and if it looks like your thing, you can help support it. The important thing is the number of preorders not how much money is collected.

https://www.inkshares.com/books/dragonford-the-long-highway
